name: NYC PolicyScope — Full Newsletter Pipeline
description:
Webhook-triggered pipeline. Optional: generates AI snippet blocks from raw news. Always: validates content, generates images, renders HTML, saves output.

Supports two modes:
  1. blocks mode: raw_news_file provided → generate_snippets.py → newsletter_blocks.json → validate_blocks.py → render
  2. flat mode: content_file provided → validate_json.py → render

Triggered by nanoclaw or directly via POST.

nodes.name: Webhook: Run Newsletter Pipeline
Generate Snippet Blocks (AI)
nodes.notes:
Runs only in blocks mode (raw_news_file was provided).
Calls OpenAI to generate newsletter_blocks.json from raw news input.
Requires OPENAI_API_KEY in environment.
Output: data/output/blocks_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.json

nodes.name: Validate Flat Content JSON
nodes.notes: Validates legacy flat content against schemas/newsletter.json.

nodes.name: Generate Newsletter Image
nodes.notes:
Uses Imagen 2 via Google AI Studio API. Raw PNG — no Gemini logo.
Skip this node if generate_images is false.

nodes.name: Render HTML Newsletter
nodes.notes:
render_newsletter.py auto-detects flat vs block format.
Output saved to data/output/newsletter_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.html
